[package]
name = "localsend"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"

[dependencies]
anyhow = "1.0.104"
base64 = "0.23.0"
bytes = "1.12.1"
lru = "0.18.1"
rand = "0.10.2"
serde_json = "1.0.151"
thiserror = "2.0.19"
tokio-stream = "0.1.19"
tracing = "0.1.44"
tungstenite = "0.30.0"

[dependencies.ed25519-dalek]
version = "3.0.0"
features = ["pem", "rand_core"]
optional = true

[dependencies.flate2]
version = "1.1.9"
optional = true

[dependencies.form_urlencoded]
version = "1.2.2"
optional = true

[dependencies.futures-util]
version = "0.3.33"
features = ["sink"]

[dependencies.http-body-util]
version = "0.1.4"
optional = true

[dependencies.hyper]
version = "1.11.0"
optional = true

[dependencies.if-addrs]
version = "0.15.0"
optional = true

[dependencies.hyper-util]
version = "0.1.20"
features = ["server"]
optional = true

[dependencies.pem]
version = "4.0.0"
optional = true

[dependencies.percent-encoding]
version = "2.3.2"
optional = true

[dependencies.rcgen]
version = "0.14.8"
default-features = false
features = ["crypto", "pem", "ring"]
optional = true

[dependencies.reqwest]
version = "0.13.4"
features = ["charset", "http2", "json", "rustls-no-provider", "stream"]
default-features = false
optional = true

[dependencies.rsa]
version = "0.9.10"
features = ["sha2"]
optional = true

[dependencies.rustls]
version = "0.23.43"
default-features = false
features = ["ring", "tls12", "std"]
optional = true

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1.0.229"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.sha2]
version = "0.11.0"
optional = true

[dependencies.socket2]
version = "0.6.5"
optional = true

[dependencies.time]
version = "0.3.54"
features = ["formatting", "parsing"]
optional = true

[dependencies.tokio]
version = "1.53.1"
features = ["full"]

[dependencies.tokio-rustls]
version = "0.26.4"
default-features = false
features = ["ring", "tls12"]
optional = true

[dependencies.tokio-tungstenite]
version = "0.30.0"
features = ["rustls-tls-webpki-roots"]
optional = true

[dependencies.tokio-util]
version = "0.7.19"
features = ["rt"]
optional = true

[dependencies.tracing-subscriber]
version = "0.3.23"

[dependencies.uuid]
version = "1.24.0"
features = ["serde", "v4"]

[dependencies.webrtc]
version = "0.14.0"
optional = true

[dependencies.x509-parser]
version = "0.18.1"
features = ["verify"]
optional = true

[target."cfg(unix)".dependencies]
libc = "0.2"

[[example]]
name = "stress_send"
required-features = ["http"]

[features]
default = []
crypto = ["ed25519-dalek", "rcgen", "rsa", "sha2", "tokio-util"]
discovery = ["http", "multicast"]
http = ["crypto", "form_urlencoded", "http-body-util", "hyper", "hyper-util", "if-addrs", "pem", "percent-encoding", "reqwest", "rustls", "socket2", "time", "tokio-rustls", "tokio-util", "x509-parser"]
multicast = ["if-addrs", "socket2", "tokio-util"]
webrtc-signaling = ["tokio-tungstenite"]
webrtc = ["crypto", "flate2", "dep:webrtc", "webrtc-signaling", "x509-parser"]
full = ["crypto", "discovery", "http", "multicast", "webrtc"]

[package]
name = "tauri"
version = "2.11.5"
description = "Make tiny, secure apps for all desktop platforms with Tauri"
exclude = ["/test", "/.scripts", "CHANGELOG.md", "/target"]
readme = "README.md"
links = "Tauri"
authors = ["Tauri Programme within The Commons Conservancy"]
homepage = "https://tauri.app/"
repository = "https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri"
categories = ["gui", "web-programming"]
license = "Apache-2.0 OR MIT"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.95"

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
no-default-features = true
features = ["wry", "unstable", "custom-protocol", "tray-icon", "devtools", "image-png", "protocol-asset", "test", "specta", "dynamic-acl", "isolation"]
default-target = "x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu"
targets = ["x86_64-pc-windows-msvc", "x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu", "x86_64-apple-darwin", "x86_64-linux-android", "x86_64-apple-ios"]

[package.metadata.cargo-udeps.ignore]
normal = ["reqwest"]
build = ["tauri-build"]
development = ["quickcheck_macros"]

[dependencies]
url = "2"
anyhow = "1"
thiserror = "2"
getrandom = "0.3"
serde_repr = "0.1"
http = "1"
dirs = "6"
percent-encoding = "2"
glob = "0.3"
mime = "0.3"
serialize-to-javascript = "0.1.2"
heck = "0.5"
log = "0.4.21"
dunce = "1"
cookie = "0.18"

[dependencies.serde_json]
version = "1"
features = ["raw_value"]

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
features = ["derive", "rc"]

[dependencies.tokio]
version = "1"
features = ["rt", "rt-multi-thread", "sync", "fs", "io-util"]

[dependencies.uuid]
version = "1"
features = ["v4"]
optional = true

[dependencies.tauri-runtime]
version = "~2.11.3"
path = "./crates/tauri-runtime"

[dependencies.tauri-macros]
version = "~2.6.3"
path = "./crates/tauri-macros"

[dependencies.tauri-utils]
features = ["resources"]
version = "~2.9.3"
path = "./crates/tauri-utils"

[dependencies.tauri-runtime-wry]
optional = true
version = "~2.11.4"
path = "./crates/tauri-runtime-wry"
default-features = false

[dependencies.tauri-runtime-cef]
optional = true
version = "~0.1.0"
path = "./crates/tauri-runtime-cef"
default-features = false

[dependencies.raw-window-handle]
version = "0.6"
features = ["std"]

[dependencies.data-url]
version = "0.3"
optional = true

[dependencies.image]
version = "0.25"
default-features = false
optional = true

[dependencies.http-range]
version = "0.1"
optional = true

[dependencies.tracing]
version = "0.1"
optional = true

[dependencies.specta]
version = "^2.0.0-rc.25"
optional = true
default-features = false
features = ["function", "derive", "std"]

[dependencies.bytes]
version = "1"
features = ["serde"]

[dependencies.reqwest]
version = "0.13"
default-features = false
features = ["json", "stream"]

[dependencies.rustls]
version = "0.23"
default-features = false
features = ["ring"]
optional = true

[target."cfg(any(target_os = \"linux\", target_os = \"dragonfly\", target_os = \"freebsd\", target_os = \"openbsd\", target_os = \"netbsd\", target_os = \"windows\", target_os = \"macos\"))".dependencies.muda]
version = "0.19"
default-features = false
features = ["serde", "gtk"]

[target."cfg(any(target_os = \"linux\", target_os = \"dragonfly\", target_os = \"freebsd\", target_os = \"openbsd\", target_os = \"netbsd\", target_os = \"windows\", target_os = \"macos\"))".dependencies.tray-icon]
version = "0.24"
default-features = false
features = ["serde", "gtk"]
optional = true

[target."cfg(any(target_os = \"linux\", target_os = \"dragonfly\", target_os = \"freebsd\", target_os = \"openbsd\", target_os = \"netbsd\"))".dependencies.gtk]
version = "0.18"
features = ["v3_24"]

[target."cfg(any(target_os = \"linux\", target_os = \"dragonfly\", target_os = \"freebsd\", target_os = \"openbsd\", target_os = \"netbsd\"))".dependencies.webkit2gtk]
version = "2"
features = ["v2_40"]
optional = true

[target."cfg(target_vendor = \"apple\")".dependencies]
objc2 = "0.6"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies]
embed_plist = "1.2"
plist = "1"
window-vibrancy = "0.6"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies.objc2-foundation]
version = "0.3.2"
default-features = false
features = ["std", "NSData", "NSThread"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies.objc2-app-kit]
version = "0.3.2"
default-features = false
features = ["std", "NSApplication", "NSColor", "NSResponder", "NSView", "NSWindow", "NSImage"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies.objc2-web-kit]
version = "0.3.2"
default-features = false
features = ["objc2-app-kit", "WKWebView", "WKWebViewConfiguration", "WKUserContentController"]

[target."cfg(windows)".dependencies]
window-vibrancy = "0.6"

[target."cfg(windows)".dependencies.webview2-com]
version = "0.38"
optional = true

[target."cfg(windows)".dependencies.windows]
version = "0.61"
features = ["Win32_Foundation", "Win32_UI", "Win32_UI_WindowsAndMessaging"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"android\")".dependencies]
jni = "0.21"

[target."cfg(all(target_vendor = \"apple\", not(target_os = \"macos\")))".dependencies]
libc = "0.2"
swift-rs = "1.0.8"

[target."cfg(all(target_vendor = \"apple\", not(target_os = \"macos\")))".dependencies.objc2-ui-kit]
version = "0.3.2"
default-features = false
features = ["UIApplication", "UIResponder", "UIView"]

[build-dependencies]
glob = "0.3"
heck = "0.5"

[build-dependencies.tauri-build]
version = "2.6.3"
path = "./crates/tauri-build"
default-features = false

[build-dependencies.tauri-utils]
features = ["build-2"]
version = "~2.9.3"
path = "./crates/tauri-utils"

[dev-dependencies]
proptest = "1.6.0"
quickcheck = "1.0.3"
quickcheck_macros = "1.0.0"
serde_json = "1"
cargo_toml = "1.0"
http-range = "0.1.5"

[dev-dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
features = ["derive"]

[dev-dependencies.tauri]
path = "."
default-features = false

[dev-dependencies.tokio]
version = "1"
features = ["full"]

[features]
default = ["wry", "compression", "common-controls-v6", "dynamic-acl", "x11", "dbus"]
unstable = ["tauri-runtime-wry?/unstable"]
x11 = ["tauri-runtime-wry?/x11"]
dbus = ["tauri-runtime-wry?/dbus"]
common-controls-v6 = ["tray-icon?/common-controls-v6", "muda/common-controls-v6", "tauri-runtime-wry?/common-controls-v6"]
tray-icon = ["dep:tray-icon"]
tracing = ["dep:tracing", "tauri-macros/tracing", "tauri-runtime-wry?/tracing"]
test = []
compression = ["tauri-macros/compression", "tauri-utils/compression"]
wry = ["dep:webview2-com", "dep:webkit2gtk", "dep:tauri-runtime-wry"]
cef = ["dep:tauri-runtime-cef"]
objc-exception = []
linux-libxdo = ["tray-icon/libxdo", "muda/libxdo"]
isolation = ["tauri-utils/isolation", "tauri-macros/isolation", "uuid"]
custom-protocol = ["tauri-macros/custom-protocol"]
native-tls = ["reqwest/native-tls"]
native-tls-vendored = ["reqwest/native-tls-vendored"]
rustls-tls = ["reqwest/rustls-no-provider", "dep:rustls"]
devtools = ["tauri-runtime/devtools", "tauri-runtime-wry?/devtools", "tauri-runtime-cef?/devtools"]
process-relaunch-dangerous-allow-symlink-macos = ["tauri-utils/process-relaunch-dangerous-allow-symlink-macos"]
macos-private-api = ["tauri-runtime/macos-private-api", "tauri-runtime-wry?/macos-private-api", "tauri-runtime-cef?/macos-private-api"]
webview-data-url = ["data-url", "tauri-utils/html-manipulation-2"]
protocol-asset = ["http-range"]
config-json5 = ["tauri-macros/config-json5"]
config-toml = ["tauri-macros/config-toml"]
image-ico = ["image/ico"]
image-png = ["image/png"]
macos-proxy = ["tauri-runtime-wry?/macos-proxy"]
dynamic-acl = []
specta = ["dep:specta"]

[[example]]
name = "commands"
path = "../../examples/commands/main.rs"

[[example]]
name = "helloworld"
path = "../../examples/helloworld/main.rs"

[[example]]
name = "drag"
path = "../../examples/drag/main.rs"

[[example]]
name = "multiwebview"
path = "../../examples/multiwebview/main.rs"
required-features = ["unstable"]

[[example]]
name = "multiwindow"
path = "../../examples/multiwindow/main.rs"

[[example]]
name = "run-return"
path = "../../examples/run-return/main.rs"

[[example]]
name = "splashscreen"
path = "../../examples/splashscreen/main.rs"

[[example]]
name = "state"
path = "../../examples/state/main.rs"

[[example]]
name = "streaming"
path = "../../examples/streaming/main.rs"

[[example]]
name = "isolation"
path = "../../examples/isolation/main.rs"
required-features = ["isolation"]

[package]
name = "tauri-build"
version = "2.6.3"
description = "build time code to pair with https://crates.io/crates/tauri"
exclude = ["CHANGELOG.md", "/target"]
readme = "README.md"
authors = ["Tauri Programme within The Commons Conservancy"]
homepage = "https://tauri.app/"
repository = "https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri"
categories = ["gui", "web-programming"]
license = "Apache-2.0 OR MIT"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.95"

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
all-features = true
default-target = "x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu"
targets = ["x86_64-pc-windows-msvc", "x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu", "x86_64-apple-darwin", "x86_64-linux-android", "x86_64-apple-ios"]

[dependencies]
anyhow = "1"
cargo_toml = "1.0"
serde = "1"
serde_json = "1"
heck = "0.5"
json-patch = "4"
walkdir = "2"
tauri-winres = "0.3"
semver = "1"
dirs = "6"
glob = "0.3"

[dependencies.quote]
version = "1"
optional = true

[dependencies.tauri-codegen]
optional = true
version = "~2.6.3"
path = "./crates/tauri-codegen"

[dependencies.tauri-utils]
features = ["build-2", "resources"]
version = "~2.9.3"
path = "./crates/tauri-utils"

[dependencies.schemars]
version = "1"
features = ["preserve_order"]

[features]
default = ["config-json"]
codegen = ["tauri-codegen", "quote"]
isolation = ["tauri-codegen/isolation", "tauri-utils/isolation"]
config-json = []
config-json5 = ["tauri-utils/config-json5"]
config-toml = ["tauri-utils/config-toml"]

[package]
name = "tauri-codegen"
version = "2.6.3"
description = "code generation meant to be consumed inside of `tauri` through `tauri-build` or `tauri-macros`"
exclude = ["CHANGELOG.md", "/target"]
readme = "README.md"
authors = ["Tauri Programme within The Commons Conservancy"]
homepage = "https://tauri.app/"
repository = "https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri"
categories = ["gui", "web-programming"]
license = "Apache-2.0 OR MIT"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.95"

[dependencies]
sha2 = "0.10"
base64 = "0.22"
proc-macro2 = "1"
quote = "1"
syn = "2"
serde_json = "1"
thiserror = "2"
walkdir = "2"
semver = "1"
ico = "0.5"
png = "0.18"
json-patch = "4"
url = "2"

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.tauri-utils]
features = ["build-2"]
version = "~2.9.3"
path = "./crates/tauri-utils"

[dependencies.brotli]
version = "8"
optional = true
default-features = false
features = ["std"]

[dependencies.uuid]
version = "1"
features = ["v4"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies]
plist = "1"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies.time]
version = "0.3"
features = ["parsing", "formatting"]

[features]
compression = ["brotli", "tauri-utils/compression"]
isolation = ["tauri-utils/isolation"]
config-json5 = ["tauri-utils/config-json5"]
config-toml = ["tauri-utils/config-toml"]

[package]
name = "tauri-macros"
version = "2.6.3"
description = "Macros for the tauri crate."
exclude = ["CHANGELOG.md", "/target"]
readme = "README.md"
authors = ["Tauri Programme within The Commons Conservancy"]
homepage = "https://tauri.app/"
repository = "https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri"
categories = ["gui", "web-programming"]
license = "Apache-2.0 OR MIT"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.95"

[lib]
proc-macro = true

[dependencies]
quote = "1"
heck = "0.5"

[dependencies.proc-macro2]
version = "1"
features = ["span-locations"]

[dependencies.syn]
version = "2"
features = ["full"]

[dependencies.tauri-codegen]
version = "~2.6.3"
path = "./crates/tauri-codegen"

[dependencies.tauri-utils]
version = "~2.9.3"
path = "./crates/tauri-utils"

[features]
custom-protocol = []
compression = ["tauri-codegen/compression"]
isolation = ["tauri-codegen/isolation"]
config-json5 = ["tauri-codegen/config-json5", "tauri-utils/config-json5"]
config-toml = ["tauri-codegen/config-toml", "tauri-utils/config-toml"]
tracing = []

[package]
name = "tauri-plugin"
version = "2.6.3"
description = "Build script and runtime Tauri plugin definitions"
authors = ["Tauri Programme within The Commons Conservancy"]
homepage = "https://tauri.app/"
repository = "https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri"
categories = ["gui", "web-programming"]
license = "Apache-2.0 OR MIT"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.95"

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
features = ["build", "runtime"]

[features]
build = ["dep:anyhow", "dep:serde", "dep:serde_json", "dep:glob", "dep:plist", "dep:walkdir"]
runtime = []

[dependencies.anyhow]
version = "1"
optional = true

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
optional = true

[dependencies.tauri-utils]
features = ["build-2"]
version = "~2.9.3"
path = "./crates/tauri-utils"

[dependencies.serde_json]
version = "1"
optional = true

[dependencies.glob]
version = "0.3"
optional = true

[dependencies.schemars]
version = "1"
features = ["preserve_order"]

[dependencies.walkdir]
version = "2"
optional = true

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies.plist]
version = "1"
optional = true

[package]
name = "tauri-plugin-biometric"
version = "2.3.2"
description = "Prompt the user for biometric authentication on Android and iOS."
edition = "2021"
authors = ["Tauri Programme within The Commons Conservancy"]
license = "Apache-2.0 OR MIT"
repository = "https://github.com/tauri-apps/plugins-workspace"
links = "tauri-plugin-biometric"

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
targets = ["x86_64-linux-android"]

[package.metadata.platforms.support.windows]
level = "none"
notes = ""

[package.metadata.platforms.support.linux]
level = "none"
notes = ""

[package.metadata.platforms.support.macos]
level = "none"
notes = ""

[package.metadata.platforms.support.android]
level = "full"
notes = ""

[package.metadata.platforms.support.ios]
level = "full"
notes = ""

[build-dependencies.tauri-plugin]
features = ["build"]
version = "2.5"

[dependencies]
serde_json = "1"
log = "0.4"
thiserror = "2"
serde_repr = "0.1"

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.tauri]
version = "2.10"
default-features = false

[package]
name = "tauri-plugin-cli"
version = "2.4.1"
description = "Parse arguments from your Tauri application's command line interface."
edition = "2021"
authors = ["Tauri Programme within The Commons Conservancy"]
license = "Apache-2.0 OR MIT"
rust-version = "1.77.2"
repository = "https://github.com/tauri-apps/plugins-workspace"
links = "tauri-plugin-cli"

[package.metadata.platforms.support.windows]
level = "full"
notes = ""

[package.metadata.platforms.support.linux]
level = "full"
notes = ""

[package.metadata.platforms.support.macos]
level = "full"
notes = ""

[package.metadata.platforms.support.android]
level = "none"
notes = ""

[package.metadata.platforms.support.ios]
level = "none"
notes = ""

[build-dependencies.tauri-plugin]
features = ["build"]
version = "2.5"

[dependencies]
serde_json = "1"
log = "0.4"
thiserror = "2"

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.tauri]
version = "2.10"
default-features = false

[dependencies.clap]
version = "4"
features = ["string"]

[package]
name = "tauri-plugin-clipboard-manager"
version = "2.3.2"
description = "Read and write to the system clipboard."
edition = "2021"
authors = ["Tauri Programme within The Commons Conservancy"]
license = "Apache-2.0 OR MIT"
rust-version = "1.77.2"
repository = "https://github.com/tauri-apps/plugins-workspace"
links = "tauri-plugin-clipboard-manager"

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
targets = ["x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu", "x86_64-linux-android"]

[package.metadata.platforms.support.windows]
level = "full"
notes = ""

[package.metadata.platforms.support.linux]
level = "full"
notes = ""

[package.metadata.platforms.support.macos]
level = "full"
notes = ""

[package.metadata.platforms.support.android]
level = "partial"
notes = "Only plain-text content support"

[package.metadata.platforms.support.ios]
level = "partial"
notes = "Only plain-text content support"

[build-dependencies.tauri-plugin]
features = ["build"]
version = "2.5"

[dependencies]
serde_json = "1"
log = "0.4"
thiserror = "2"

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.tauri]
version = "2.10"
default-features = false

[target."cfg(target_os = \"ios\")".dependencies.tauri]
features = ["wry"]
version = "2.10"
default-features = false

[target."cfg(any(target_os = \"macos\", windows, target_os = \"linux\", target_os = \"dragonfly\", target_os = \"freebsd\", target_os = \"openbsd\", target_os = \"netbsd\"))".dependencies.arboard]
version = "3"
features = ["wayland-data-control"]

[package]
name = "tauri-plugin-deep-link"
version = "2.4.9"
description = "Set your Tauri application as the default handler for an URL"
authors = ["Tauri Programme within The Commons Conservancy"]
license = "Apache-2.0 OR MIT"
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.77.2"
repository = "https://github.com/tauri-apps/plugins-workspace"
links = "tauri-plugin-deep-link"

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
targets = ["x86_64-linux-android"]

[package.metadata.platforms.support.windows]
level = "full"
notes = ""

[package.metadata.platforms.support.linux]
level = "full"
notes = ""

[package.metadata.platforms.support.macos]
level = "partial"
notes = "Deep links must be registered in config. Dynamic registration at runtime is not supported."

[package.metadata.platforms.support.android]
level = "partial"
notes = "Deep links must be registered in config. Dynamic registration at runtime is not supported."
